howToPlay: Pierce is a marksman who relies on managing ammo to maximize damage with the final shot. Collect the dropped shells to trigger automatic piercing attacks and reload your magazine. Use gadgets and movement to strategically position yourself while gathering shells to maintain pressure.
gears: Equip DAMAGE and SPEED to capitalize on the high damage output of the final shot and maneuver quickly across the map. SHIELD provides necessary durability for a brawler with 3000 health.
trait: This brawler is perfect for precise players who enjoy tactical ammo management and rewarding, skill-based mechanics.
